title: Metabolism VFS File Names
description: Fix sketchpad VFS showing file GUIDs instead of names for metabolism kit after installProjection.
summary: Fixed metabolism kit files showing UUIDs in sketchpad VFS: `initial_kit_projection_value` now round-trips file `name`, `folder`, `mime`, and `icon`; added folder projection/hydration. Corrected JS VFS folder children query (`subFolders`, drop invalid `typologies`). Added Rust + JS tests.
